scope: Owner-approved domestic purchase and inventory GST policy enforcement
failClosedControls: Inclusive GST purchase creation is rejected until governed Rule 35 extraction and rounding are enabled.
Non-zero declared cess is rejected until a governed cess rule and utilization policy are configured.
Non-zero accepted cess cannot complete accounting acceptance without governed support.
GST discrepancies retain supplier and calculated values and require attributable resolution.
nonClaims: No professional or legal GST conclusion is claimed.
No inventory valuation policy is inferred from purchase_rate.
No production or Live Supabase operation was performed.
No new runtime accounting evidence is claimed beyond the focused policy contracts.
